Data updates

The following data changes (m25.0) have been added relative to the SSC accepted model in 2023 (Model 2020.1-2023).

Catch data

  • Total catch was input for 2023, 2024, and 2025.
    • Partial catch was input for 2026.

Survey data

  • Survey biomass estimates for 2025

Composition data

  • Survey age composition data for 2023 & 2025
  • Fishery age composition data for 2024

Plan Team & SSC Notes

Proposed model changes Sep 2025:

  • Full form nLL for catch and survey biomass (m25.1)
  • Change 2nd fishery slx block to Gamma function (match blocks 3 & 4) (m25.2
  • Francis reweighting of compositional data (m25.2a)

Recommendations:

  • Update survey age composition input sample sizes using the surveyISS package
    • provide a table of ISS for all fleets and the final adjusted sample sizes after any reweighting
  • Evaluate the ratios of effective sample size (ESS) to ISS and provide interpretations of results, particularly when ESS/ISS is greater than 1.0
  • The Team suggested the authors bring forward a model run using the model-based index, if time permits.
    • Investigate the differences in the coefficients of variation estimates between the 2023 and 2025 model-based indices
  • Bring forward m25.2a

Alternatives explored

Structural

  • m25.0 - base model, update data
  • m25.1 - srv & catch likelihood, prior and compositional data likelihoods use RTMB::dnorm or RTMB::rmultinom
  • m25.2 - change 2nd slx timeblock to Gamma (dome-shaped) to remove averegae

Input updates

  • .a - update survey age comp ISS
  • .b - change to design-based survey biomass
  • .c - change 2nd slx timeblock to Gamma
  • .r - Francis reweighting

Survey data

There were changes made by the Groundfish Assessment Program (GAP) in how survey data were processed between the 2023 and 2025 surveys. Therefore, the design-based index changed slightly between years, both are presented here but they are generally equivalent. The 2026 GOA Pacific ocean perch base model (m25.0) assessment uses the 2025 design-based survey biomass estimates.

Notes

  • The model-based index in 2023 was estimated using VAST,
  • The model-based index in 2025 was estimated using sdmTMB, the GAP has done a bridging exercise to demonstrate the same results from the software variants,
  • The 2025 Gulf of Alaska survey sampled 431 hauls, down from the 523 hauls sampled in 2023.

Survey age composition data

Survey age compositions were updated to include data from 2023 and 2025. There continues to be an increase in the number of fish allocated to the age-25+ group.

Fishery age composition data

Fishery age compositions were updated to include data from 2024. There continues to be an increase in the number of fish allocated to the age-25+ group.
